title: Bash Metadata — Tier 2 (Partial)
description: Partial metadata for the Bash tool. Provenance is required. koth and decision are optional but recommended for consequential commands (git push, npm publish, destructive operations). experiment and _compat are not applicable.

notes.koth.outcome_signal: Set by PostToolUse based on exit code: exit 0 = 'win', non-zero = 'loss'.
notes.koth.koth_domain: Set to the domain of the command (e.g., 'devops' for infrastructure commands, 'editing' for file manipulation).
notes.decision.signal_type: Typically 'post_decision' — Bash executes a decision already made.
notes.experiment: NOT applicable for Bash — omit entirely.
